name: app.cobd/cobd
title: cOBD
description: Your car's drives, fuel use and engine health from its OBD-II port. Explains any fault code.

tools.name: explain_fault_code
tools.description: What an OBD-II fault code means, how serious it is, common causes and what to do. Example: P0420.

code.description: A fault code such as P0420

tools.name: search_fault_codes
tools.description: Find fault codes by the words in their name, such as "misfire cylinder 3", or look up one code.

query.description: A few words or a code

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: about_cobd
tools.description: What cOBD is, what it needs, the Free and Pro plans and where to start.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: The latest public posts, newest first.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: read_news
tools.description: The text of one public post. Use a slug from list_news.

tools.name: list_cars
tools.description: The driver's cars with their ids and last drive, and the driver's plan.

tools.name: get_car_status
tools.description: The latest readings from one car, such as engine speed, coolant, fuel level and battery, and its check-engine state.

car_id.description: A car id from list_cars. Without it, the car driven last.

tools.name: get_fault_codes
tools.description: The fault codes one car reported, whether each is still active, and what it means.

car_id.description: A car id from list_cars. Without it, the car driven last.

tools.name: list_drives
tools.description: One car's drives, newest first, with distance, time, speed, fuel used and weather.

car_id.description: A car id from list_cars. Without it, the car driven last.

from.description: Drives from this day, such as 2026-03-01, or an ISO time with Z or an offset

to.description: Drives up to the end of this day, or up to an ISO time with Z or an offset

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

tools.name: get_fuel
tools.description: One car's fuel level and range, and its fuel economy over recent days.

car_id.description: A car id from list_cars. Without it, the car driven last.

days.description: Days of driving for the economy, 1 to 365. Default 30.

tools.name: get_health_score
tools.description: One car's engine health score from 0 to 100, part by part. Pro plan.

car_id.description: A car id from list_cars. Without it, the car driven last.

tools.name: get_drive_score
tools.description: How smoothly one car was driven, from hard braking, acceleration and cornering. Pro plan.

car_id.description: A car id from list_cars. Without it, the car driven last.

days.description: Days of driving to score, 1 to 365. Default 30.

tools.name: get_car_location
tools.description: Where one car was last, with a map link. The driver allows this separately.

car_id.description: A car id from list_cars. Without it, the car driven last.
